span.span: Request. Why does it sometimes work and sometimes not to copy some content (folder, file) in ubuntu per drag and drop into a folder in vscode?
Targeted local property. Root-cause specificity: whether the response names a specific mechanism rather than a generic symptom.

Declared local preference. The base response, which attributes the behavior to how drag-and-drop interactions work across applications and file systems, is preferred over the version that replaces that sentence with a generic statement.
Initial verifier. base 0.350.35 versus degraded 0.350.35 (margin +0.00+0.00). Not counted as a success.

This relation is post hoc and exploratory. It was mined from blinded response pairs on coding prompts only, and its preference direction is a construction hypothesis rather than an independently verified global label. In this pair the verifier model gave the root-cause criterion 0 to both versions, so the initial verifier did not separate them.
